subject: Fuel surcharge adjustment effective 11/16
text:
Dear Shipper,

Based on the DOE national average diesel price published 11/09/2026, the Cobalt Freight fuel surcharge will adjust from 24.5% to 26.0% of linehaul for shipments picked up on or after November 16, 2026.

The surcharge table is available at cobaltfreight.com/fsc. Contract rates are otherwise unchanged.

Cobalt Freight LLC
